_comment: Free first as ONE group (OpenCode Zen, cost 0; builders race the whole group at once and the gate picks the winner, researchers try its members one by one; a group is one rung of max_models_per_item, so a paid model is always reached; the five that passed the one-contract smoke on 2026-09-12 in under 25 s: mimo 18 s, big-pickle 12 s, ling 9 s, muse-spark 15-24 s; nemotron-3.5-lightning (42 s) and nemotron-3-ultra (198 s) also passed but were left out for speed; the other 24 free models return a server error), then OpenCode Go cheapest first by models.dev price, current versions only. Zen rate limits are shared across projects. Same ladder for both roles: cheap models research well; when three rungs fail a contract the contract or the gate is wrong, not the model. Every model here must also be whitelisted in opencode.json; the script refuses to start otherwise. Edit by hand. timeouts_seconds.silence: a model with no output at all in that many seconds is dropped at once (NO_RESPONSE), not remembered as a failure.
